description.value:
You're in a severely thick atmosphere, like those deep inside gas giants, where the air is so dense and pressurized it's nearly impossible to breathe.

Each minute you breathe it, you need to succeed at a Fortitude save or become sickened 2 until you're back in normal air. Without protection, the pressure also deals 4d6 to 6d6 bludgeoning damage every minute, whether or not you succeed at the save.

Basic environmental protection can't handle this, but a tactical filtered air supply can.
